input.description:
Search for a PRD document related to OSAC-1567 and Secret Management in the OSAC project. Look in these locations:
1. /opt/forge/ directory and subdirectories
2. Any file with "1567" in the name or path
3. Any file with "secret" or "secret-management" in the name
4. Any PRD files in the OSAC project directory

Return the full content of any PRD you find, along with its file path. If you find multiple files, return all of them.
